WITH future_nodes AS ( SELECT event.id AS publicMatterId, event.title AS name, node.id AS timeNodeId, node.label AS nodeName, node.start_time AS reminderAt FROM exam_info event INNER JOIN timeline node ON node.target_type = 3 AND node.target_id = event.id AND node.start_time > #{evaluatedAt} WHERE event.publish_status = 1 AND event.status NOT IN (4, 6) AND event.cancelled_at IS NULL AND event.deleted_at IS NULL AND (event.end_precision = 0 OR event.end_time IS NULL OR #{evaluatedAt} < CASE WHEN event.end_precision = 1 THEN DATE_ADD(DATE(event.end_time), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ELSE event.end_time END)
UNION ALL
SELECT event.id AS publicMatterId, event.title AS name, NULL AS timeNodeId, '事项开始' AS nodeName, event.start_time AS reminderAt FROM exam_info event WHERE event.publish_status = 1 AND event.status NOT IN (4, 6) AND event.cancelled_at IS NULL AND event.deleted_at IS NULL AND event.start_time > #{evaluatedAt} AND (event.end_precision = 0 OR event.end_time IS NULL OR #{evaluatedAt} < CASE WHEN event.end_precision = 1 THEN DATE_ADD(DATE(event.end_time), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ELSE event.end_time END) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM timeline future_node WHERE future_node.target_type = 3 AND future_node.target_id = event.id AND future_node.start_time > #{evaluatedAt} ) ), ranked_nodes AS ( SELECT node.publicMatterId, node.name, node.timeNodeId, node.nodeName, node.reminderAt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY node.publicMatterId ORDER BY node.reminderAt ASC, COALESCE(node.timeNodeId, 0) ASC ) AS nodeRank FROM future_nodes node ), eligible_nodes AS ( SELECT node.publicMatterId, node.name, node.timeNodeId, node.nodeName, node.reminderAt FROM ranked_nodes node WHERE node.nodeRank = 1 ), subscribed_nodes AS ( SELECT node.publicMatterId, node.name, node.timeNodeId, node.nodeName, node.reminderAt FROM eligible_nodes node WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM exam_subscription subscription WHERE subscription.exam_info_id = node.publicMatterId AND subscription.user_id = #{userId} AND subscription.status = 1 AND subscription.notify_enable = 1 ) ), chosen_nodes AS ( SELECT subscribed.publicMatterId, subscribed.name, subscribed.timeNodeId, subscribed.nodeName, subscribed.reminderAt, 'SUBSCRIPTIONS' AS source FROM subscribed_nodes subscribed
UNION ALL
SELECT node.publicMatterId, node.name, node.timeNodeId, node.nodeName, node.reminderAt, 'DEFAULT' AS source FROM eligible_nodes node WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscribed_nodes) ) SELECT candidate.publicMatterId, candidate.name, candidate.timeNodeId, candidate.nodeName, candidate.reminderAt, candidate.source FROM chosen_nodes candidate ORDER BY candidate.reminderAt ASC, candidate.publicMatterId ASC, COALESCE(candidate.timeNodeId, 0) ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, title, exam_date AS examDate FROM exam_info WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND publish_status = 1 ORDER BY exam_date DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM exam_info WHERE id = #{examId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM exam_info WHERE id = #{examId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE exam_info SET publish_status = 1, status = 2, audit_status = 0, reject_reason = NULL, published_at = COALESCE(published_at, NOW()) WHERE id = #{id} AND publish_status IN (0, 2) AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE exam_info SET publish_status = 2, status = 0, is_pinned = FALSE WHERE id = #{id} AND publish_status = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
